newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Small tremor hits northern Netherlands.
newsitem.headline: Small tremor hits northern Netherlands.

text.p: A small earth tremor measuring 3.4 on the Richter scale occurred in the northern Dutch province of Groningen late on Wednesday, the Royal Netherlands Meteorological Institute said on Thursday.
The tremor's epicentre was five km (two miles) south of the village of Ter Apel and there were no reports of serious damage.
The institute said the earthquake was probably caused by subsidence as a result of the extraction of natural gas.
Small tremors are relatively common in the north where most of the country's gas is found, but the institute said Wednesday's quake was the strongest ever registered in the region
